mathematics.assertion_tested: Independently parsed 286 primary Pantheon+ SDSS supernovae reproduce stored AGB4 raw and corrected magnitude WLS amplitudes and standard errors; compare full covariance as a finite sensitivity.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE double precision, numpy SVD and QR
mathematics.conventions: Equal-count quantile redshift bins, om=.334, free colour/stretch for raw magnitudes, optional host mass<10 step; age template=-.030 age Gyr; diagonal C weights primary.
inputs: Snapshots of Pantheon+ data, full covariance, Sako SDSS table, and AGB4 reported fits
non_claims: No EIV modeling or cosmology refit
Full covariance sensitivity uses supplied published covariance unchanged
